title: RSVP checkpoint file, version 1
description: rsvp/checkpoints.json inside a prepared EPUB (docs/PLAN.md section 5). This schema is one layer of validation; cross-reference rules (unique ids, section references, anchor names, plain text) are applied by tools/prep/checkpoints.py and listed in tools/prep/README.md. Unknown members are allowed at every level and must be ignored by readers; a change a version 1 reader cannot safely ignore needs a new version number.
$comment: Every pattern ends in $(?!\n): Python's re.search lets $ match before a trailing newline, the lookahead closes that gap and is a no-op in ECMA-262. 'Characters' in minLength/maxLength are Unicode code points. 'integer' means a JSON number written without fraction or exponent; the Python validator enforces this with a strict type checker (stock validators would accept 1.0).

version.description: Only 1 is defined. The Python validator reports an integer above 1 as 'unsupported-version' before this schema is applied.

checkpoints.description: May be empty. Order is not significant.

id.description: ASCII letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters. Used inside XHTML ids and as keys in the state file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original EPUB as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

section.description: Id of an existing section (cross-reference rule 'unknown-section'); at most one checkpoint per section.

prompt.description: Plain text (cross-reference rules 'not-plain-text', 'blank-text'), 1 to 300 code points.

answer.description: Plain text (cross-reference rules 'not-plain-text', 'blank-text'), 1 to 600 code points.
